label: Warmer Grounded
difference_from_d: A touch more low-mid warmth and grounded resonance while preserving D's softness, wonder and pace.

parameters.voice_description: An original English-speaking mascot voice for Merc, an ageless liquid-metal adventure sprite who reads as a young adult. Soft and androgynous with a clear intimate low-mid register, gentle warmth, a little more grounded resonance, quiet wonder and an easy unhurried rhythm. Lightly melodic and whimsical while remaining natural, intelligible and emotionally present. Crisp articulation for short game dialogue. Dry, close-mic studio recording with excellent audio quality; no music, background sound or reverb. Moderate-to-soft conversational volume, never shouting. A friendly encouraging coach, never heavy, gravelly, wispy, sleepy, childish, squeaky, shrill, announcer-like or imitative.
